title: The tank step stops allocating memory
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: The tank rules now reuse their buffers instead of asking for fresh memory every tick, so once a match is warmed up a tick of the rules allocates nothing. Every pinned hash, parity fixture and replay file is unchanged. The match runner is about 10% faster, and the browser build is about 5 KB smaller. The observations given to Rust policies still allocate; changing that is a separate decision.
next: Blitzwing's tank number view and reward, then the Python package.
